title: Updating the scaling register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $13$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its scaling scratch value by $y$.
replaced:
For a register record and a natural number $y$, updating the entry at index $13$ of its
length-fifteen value vector to $y$ gives the value vector of the record obtained by
replacing the scratch value used for the scalings with $y$.
